hey people :)

i've checked the archives for the answer to this one, and didn't find anything

so here goes :

my vamp is a 5 cap, and he's at 2 blood

he diablerizes a 7 cap with 3 blood

1/ transfer all the blood left on the victim to my vamp (so my vamp is at 5 blood)

2/ transfer equipment

3/ burn the victim

4/ get an extra discipline on my vamp

5/ blood hunt on my vamp

can i play Draught of the soul (superior) between 4/ and 5/ ?

that way my vamp is at 6 cap and 6 blood

thanx

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
Sorrow wrote:
>
> > > Wouldn't it be more consistent with other rulings (i.e. Reform body) if the
> > > diablerie always is considered an atomic action, i.e. that nothing can be
> > > played within it, only after or before?
> > Yes, yes it would.
> > Reversal/Update: Diablerie is atomic - you cannot play effects within it.
> > Play Draught of the Soul after 5.
>
> Atomic? Elaborate?

The diablerie is indivisible. You can't/don't do part of it and then
do some other effect before moving on to the rest of it.

> So you can only play DotS after you've survived the blood hunt? How odd.

Yes. I'd prefer that the Blood Hunt weren't wrapped up with the rest
of the package, but the "atomic" ruling wouldn't support separating
off just the last step.

> How is this more in line with, say, Reform Body?

The victim doesn't play Reform Body at step 3 (after losing all
his equipment and blood). He plays it before step 1.
